BL-1407 — The property-suite gate re-runs a non-allowlisted red file once in isolation before it may refuse: a red that passes alone is recorded as a load flake and the commit is allowed, a red that fails alone refuses as today - five refusals in one evening blocked an approved parcel for 2.5 hours on a different unrelated red each time
What it solves: No consumer `required_wiring` anchor: the guard is already wired into
`run_commit_guards.sh` tier 2, so any anchor would be satisfied by the
parcel's own diff (BL-1235 fail-open). The shell e2e drives the real hook
path.
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. This does not weaken the gate for a real regression (invariant 1); it stops a load-dependent red in an unrelated file from refusing a commit that did not touch it, and it makes the flake visi…
BL-1407 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1407" (or "reject BL-1407 <reason>") to act.
